after_metrics.llm_replay_workflow: automatic LLM saves now create replay twins by default

before_metrics.llm_blocker: automatic pipeline did not mirror dated advice files into replay files

change_summary: Added automatic replay-log mirroring to `llm_advisor.save_advice()`: when saving a real dated `investment_advice_YYYYMMDD.json`, it now also writes `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json` unless that replay file already exists. Added targeted tests for auto-mirroring, non-overwrite behavior, and fake-response skip behavior. No strategy logic or backtester decision path changed.

delta_metrics.note: No full backtest rerun was required because no signal-generation, filtering, sizing, or exit logic changed. The deliverable is parity repair: future automatic LLM runs now accumulate replay coverage instead of silently leaving P-LLM at 0%.

hypothesis: The highest-value remaining alpha direction is `LLM soft ranking`, but it is blocked because the automatic LLM pipeline writes `investment_advice_YYYYMMDD.json` without also creating `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json`. Centralizing replay-log mirroring inside `llm_advisor.save_advice()` should unblock future P-LLM coverage accumulation without changing any trading rule, filter, sizing, or backtest metric.

blocker_proof.investment_advice_auto_mirror_missing: run_pipeline.py and automatic save path wrote dated advice but not replay twins

llm_metrics.llm_attribution_metric: future llm_attribution.coverage_fraction is no longer blocked by missing replay twins on auto-saved advice days

next_retry_requires: Let the daily pipeline accumulate new `llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json` files
Once replay coverage reaches a meaningful sample, resume `LLM soft ranking` alpha experiments instead of more trend/breakout micro-tuning
notes: This run explicitly chose measurement_repair over strategy-layer alpha_search because the strongest remaining alpha direction (`LLM soft ranking`) is not currently trustworthy to evaluate while automatic pipeline runs fail to persist replay twins.

fake_response_policy.new: skip replay if parsed payload has no new_trade key

save_advice_auto_replay.new: also writes llm_prompt_resp_YYYYMMDD.json for real dated advice saves
